description: This file defines an advanced data type for representing IP addresses and CIDR ranges, including functions for converting request data into response format and translating filter conditions into SQLAlchemy expressions.

classes.name: AdvancedDataType
classes.description: Represents a custom data type for IP and CIDR ranges with filter translation capabilities.

methods.name: cidr_func
methods.description: Converts an AdvancedDataTypeRequest into an AdvancedDataTypeResponse, parsing IP/CIDR values.

methods.name: cidr_translate_filter_func
methods.description: Translates filter conditions into SQLAlchemy expressions for IP/CIDR range filtering.
